name: Raging Bull
effect: Striking. Ignores Screens. Reduce the duration of Screens on the target's side of the battlefield by 2 Rounds. On a Critical Strike, reduce the duration by 3 Rounds instead. If the target is behind any active Screens when performed, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool. If the User has more than one type, this move matches their secondary type.
description: The Pokémon performs a tackle like a raging bull, smashing anything in its way to the target.
